subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: What deletion contract should apply when agent-owned cron jobs cannot be atomically disabled with agent removal?
rationale: Scheduler mutation and config deletion are separate durable owners, while the existing CLI also promises an offline fallback; choosing whether to fail closed, journal deferred cleanup, or narrow the feature is a compatibility and product decision rather than a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Journal and fail closed
options.body: Add a durable resumable deletion record, require scheduler teardown before agent removal, and refuse offline deletion until cleanup can be proven or repaired.

options.title: Narrow to Claw removal
options.body: Keep generic `agents delete` unchanged for now and scope cron teardown to the Claw lifecycle until a complete cross-owner deletion design is approved.

options.title: Pause and restack
options.body: Extract the Gateway cron primitive into an independently reviewable slice and defer deletion integration until the lifecycle and outage contracts are settled.

recommendation.title: Journal and fail closed
recommendation.body: Add a durable resumable deletion record, require scheduler teardown before agent removal, and refuse offline deletion until cleanup can be proven or repaired.
